script:
ssh -i /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-known-hosts ubuntu@172.31.25.147 'sudo /bin/bash -s' <<'RPS_SSH_INNER'
set -Eeuo pipefail
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.used,utilization.gpu,power.draw --format=csv
ps -eo pid,stat,etime,pcpu,pmem,rss,args | rg 'EngineCore|vllm_rps_h100|vllm_rps_server' | head -10
for p in $(pgrep -f 'EngineCore'); do cat /proc/$p/io || true; done
ls -lh /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b
find /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b -maxdepth 2 -name '*.safetensors' -printf '%p %s\n'
tail -12 /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/runs/h100-fp8-v1/b1/server-0/server.log

RPS_SSH_INNER
